WHO WE ARE

Trusted real estate partner in Rawalpindi

Al-Khubaib Real Estate Marketing & Builders (Pvt) Ltd. is a SECP-registered company developing housing societies with modern amenities — mosques, parks, and planned infrastructure — all handled by one team from booking to construction. Based in Rawalpindi, we work directly with families and investors so every plot comes with a clear, honest plan from day one.

FAQ

Common Questions

What is the payment plan?

50% down payment, with the remaining balance payable over 3 years in easy monthly or quarterly installments.

Is Al-Khubaib a registered company?

Yes — Al-Khubaib Real Estate Marketing & Builders (Pvt) Ltd. is registered with SECP under CUIN 0153338, incorporated in 2020.

Can I visit the site before booking?

Yes, we encourage a site visit. Contact us on WhatsApp to arrange a convenient time.

What documents will I receive?

You'll receive an allotment letter upon booking, with full possession documents handed over on project completion.
